title: Lucky Me
description:
Ya evher try ridin' a hoss uhp a mountain? or maybe a tundra or guh-rove? well, ya know about powder snow, don't ya? yeah, it kay-yun be a real killer, ah'll tell ya that much.  Fortunately, we kay-yun adapt, help our pahrtners improve.  For powder snow, that'll be [horse hooves](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/horse_hooves.png:124:62).  Yep, equippin' thayse bad boys will let yo-wr hoss raahd all thuh powder snow ya come acraws.  What's more, ya kay-yun eve-yn enchant 'em with frost walker ta craws thuh sea.  Don't try t' wawk acraws lava, though.
Oh, an ponies don't need 'em.
